guard: The per-space artifact Object Store is created with `max_bytes: -1` so it reserves nothing against the broker's `max_file_store`; a store left at the legacy stock 4 GiB is reconciled to -1 and read back; any other positive cap is still refused as drift rather than widened.
why: The suite imports `setupSpaceStreams` from `src`, so no build is needed and each mutant is what the suite runs.
Each mutation is one of the three load-bearing decisions, and each reddens a DIFFERENT cell, which is what
separates them. Restoring the 4 GiB create cap reinstates the reservation, so the provisioning cell cannot
fit its spaces. Removing the legacy reconcile leaves an existing mesh holding its 4 GiB forever, so the
reconcile cell sees the cap unchanged. Widening the reconcile to ANY positive value silently removes a bound
an operator set deliberately, so the refusal cell stops refusing - the dangerous mutation, because it is the
one whose result still looks like a working fix.

mutations.name: the 4 GiB create cap is restored, so every store reserves again
mutations.expectRed: 6 spaces provision under a file store SMALLER than the old 4 GiB per-space reservation
mutations.cell: 6 spaces provision under a file store SMALLER than the old 4 GiB per-space reservation
mutations.note: This is the defect exactly as it shipped: the broker refuses the second space with JetStream error 10047 while every store is empty.

mutations.name: the legacy reconcile is removed, so an existing mesh keeps its reservation
mutations.replace:
if (false as boolean) {
    ({ config } = await jsm.streams.info(stream));
mutations.expectRed: setup reconciles the legacy 4 GiB store to -1
mutations.cell: setup reconciles the legacy 4 GiB store to -1
mutations.note: Without the update the store is left at 4 GiB and then refused as drift, so the fix would ship correct for fresh spaces and inert on every mesh that already exists.

mutations.name: the reconcile is widened to ANY positive cap, silently removing a deliberate bound
mutations.expectRed: a store at any other positive max_bytes is still REFUSED as drift
mutations.cell: a store at any other positive max_bytes is still REFUSED as drift
mutations.note: The mutant passes every other cell in the suite: it provisions, it reconciles, it round-trips. Only this cell sees that a cap nobody in this code set has been removed without anyone saying so.
